description: This file contains utility functions for matching and extracting text and attributes from DOM elements, used in selector processing within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: matchesComponentAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an object matches a component attribute selector based on a JSON path and attribute conditions.

methods.name: matchesAttributePart
methods.description: Determines if a value matches a specific attribute selector condition, supporting various operators.

methods.name: shouldSkipForTextMatching
methods.description: Decides whether an element should be skipped during text matching, e.g., script or style tags.

methods.name: elementText
methods.description: Extracts and caches the full, normalized, and immediate text content of a DOM element.

methods.name: elementMatchesText
methods.description: Checks if an element's text content matches a given text matcher, considering its children and shadow DOM.

methods.name: getElementLabels
methods.description: Retrieves accessible labels for an element via ARIA attributes or associated label elements.
